messages:
maria: Quick check — experiment proposal: build a schema-led adapter that auto-exposes lightweight REST endpoints from our protobufs for product teams. Advantage: single source of truth + console can surface mappings. Concern: how do we handle optional fields, backwards compatibility, and quotas? thoughts?

nate: I like single source. But runtime complexity worries me. Adapters need to be trivial (no heavy transcoding) or they become the gateway bottleneck.

sasha: Agree. If adapter only maps paths+query/body to proto and leaves heavy work to backend, it's fine. But we need a clear contract for unknown fields -> 400 vs passthrough.

jia: Telemetry and rollout UX: console needs to show adaptation_mode (schema vs passthrough) per-route and token cost estimate. For canary we should support header `x-edge-adapter: v2` and sampling.

ryan: Quotas: mapped REST calls may have different cost semantics than direct gRPC. We need mapping rules: default token_multiplier=1.2 for REST->proto conversions. Also rate-limit per-contracted route.

nate: Also consider client ergonomics. If we auto-generate OpenAPI stubs from proto, SDKs will be nicer. But sales teams may want stable REST patterns.

sasha: Implementation sketch:

``
# proxy mapping example
route: /v1/users/{id}
-> proto: UserService.GetUser
map: path.id -> request.user_id
adaptation: allow_unknown_fields=false
``

maria: For rollouts: plan canary at 5% traffic with fallback to legacy gateway. Need console toggle and automatic fallback on error rate > 2%.

infra-bot: deploy plan created: adapt-v2-canary -> targets: 5% prod; monitors: latency, 5xx, mismatch-errors (reaction :eyes:)

jia: Telemetry tags: [adaptation_mode, adapter_version, contract_hash, route_category] — console should show breakdown and delta vs direct gRPC baseline.

ryan: Edge-cases: streaming RPCs can't be straightforwardly mapped. We should only allow unary and server-stream if client accepts HTTP2 streaming. Mark streaming routes as unsupported for auto-mapping.

maria: Decision? Prototype an adapter that only supports unary proto, generates OpenAPI, and wires console telemetry + canary toggle. If it works, expand. Volunteers?

nate: I'll spin up a spike this week. Will open a draft PR and prototype generator + small proxy with header flagging.

sasha: I'll add telemetry env and console widgets for the canary toggle and adaptation metrics.

jia: I'll draft an RFC for error semantics and quota multipliers. Inline notes in PR.

maria: sweet. Thanks. If someone remembers, add tests for unknown-field rejection and contract drift detection. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: adapt-v2-canary -> 2024-11-03T18:20Z
